name: "Team" passwords MUST be prohibited because they make accountability impossible and are easy to steal.
conditionsText: In order to maintain accurate audit logs transactional services or services that allows users to update, delete and mantain records should all follow this rule
requirementTitle: "Team" passwords MUST be prohibited because they make accountability impossible and are easy to steal.
requirementDescription: Shared passwords used by multiple people ("team passwords") are not allowed because you cannot tell who used the account, and shared credentials are more likely to be compromised.
why: If everyone logs in using the same password and if a critical change is made, there is no way to identify who did it.
